content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Sirmaur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Sirmaur (IIM Sirmaur) located in Dhaula Kuan, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IIM Sirmaur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Medical Officer, Accreditation Executive, and Research Associate across various departments on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been announced for different posts under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIM Sirmaur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications via email is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The applications must be sent through email to [email protected] by consolidating all required documents into a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. degree with at least 60% marks, completion of compulsory rotatory internship, valid registration with Indian/State Doctors Bodies, and relevant hospital experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 25,000 for Research Associates up to Rs. 1,25,000 for Medical Officers based on the position.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to any of the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a consistent academic record, relevant work experience, and performance in the personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can download and read the official notification PDF by clicking the link provided in the important links section of this article.
